2.

Prayer in this petition is made for paying the compensation for the land of mouza Kumhardaga,
district Ramgarh, khata no.31, plot no.39, plot no.40, plot no.51, plot no.65, which were acquired for the construction of National Highway No.23 under the provision of National Highway Act, 1956.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that award has been prepared however the same has not been paid.
He submits that in view of that, a proper direction may be issued.
4. Learned counsel for State and Union of India jointly submit that there is some objection and that is why the amount has not been paid.

5. In view of above, the Court finds that there is provision under section 3-H(4) of National Highways Act, 1956 with regard to such dispute, and as such, this petition is being disposed of directing the petitioner to invoke section 3-H(4) of the said Act before the concerned respondent authority, who will take a decision in this regard in accordance with law.
6. W.P.(C) No.5772 of 2023 is accordingly disposed of.

( Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) SI/,
